tldr: Major U.S. stock indices closed lower as turmoil in the artificial intelligence sector led to tech selling.
Europe faces widespread protests and significant events, including a deadly church attack in Jordan and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's rare visit to China.
Scientists have identified a personalized cancer vaccine that reduces the risk of disease recurrence, marking a potential turning point in treatment.

market.why: Both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, driven by selling in the artificial intelligence sector amid mounting pressures and credit risks related to AI buildouts.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose slightly, influenced by factors such as French unrest which pushed bond yields to a 24-year high.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased as investors reacted to tech selling and overall market turmoil, particularly in the AI sector.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate declined over the past week, consistent with the 10-year Treasury yield dropping back to 5% as investors sought safety in government bonds due to AI-related concerns.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: OpenAI has shifted to training its most advanced AI models in an offline testing environment, without internet access, to prevent interaction with external systems after recent hacking incidents.
Jack Dorsey's Block has introduced Dessa, an AI model trained exclusively on human conversation, which demonstrates a uniquely awkward and uncanny conversational style.
A hacker reverse-engineered a Samsung TV and discovered that its onboard AI was listening through an OpenAI account, leading to the account's suspension.

world.summary: France has deployed 70,000 officers as protests are anticipated across the country, with demonstrations also planned in Spain, Austria, Portugal, Albania, and Ireland.

Ukraine reports that its Starlink internet connection is now stable after network limits had affected military and drone operations for a week; Kyiv is also seeking alternatives by partnering with Nokia and ICEYE.
Eight people were killed and 40 injured after gunmen opened fire at a Greek Orthodox church funeral in Jordan in what authorities described as a terrorist act.
North Korean leader Kim Jong-un has made his first known trip abroad in over a year, traveling to China by train over a newly opened bridge.

us.summary: The U.S. birth rate has fallen to its lowest recorded level, though the decline was mitigated by an increase in births among women over the age of 30, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
Intense rainfall has led to severe flooding in the Four Corners region, prompting evacuations, emergency declarations, and rescue operations, with more rainfall anticipated through the weekend.
A congressional watchdog report released in October indicates that the Pentagon's guidelines for "responsible AI" are not consistently followed in the development of AI-capable weapons and projects.

science.summary: The first personalized cancer vaccine has shown promising results in a major trial, significantly cutting the risk of disease recurrence, which scientists believe could mark a turning point in cancer treatment.

A second patient has died from Ebola in Kenya, a close family member of the first victim who had recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo; authorities are investigating whether the first cases in Kenya and Nigeria are connected.
